scope: Descriptive candidate selection only; screening cannot authorize adoption or a qualified effect claim.
stop_conditions: Any invalid or undefined required metric, custody, terminal, report, semantic, output, inverse, resource, allocator, or control result
Any native primary, native p99 tail, or native max_rss_kib median > 1.05
Any allocator region_peak_live_bytes or max_rss_kib median > 1.05
allocation_calls_or_requested_bytes_alon: Do not qualify as a signal or adoption claim.

equality_boundaries.signal_0_95: qualifies when all other gates pass
equality_boundaries.safety_1_05: does not stop; only values strictly greater stop

decision_if_no_stop: Require independent full confirmation and regression review; never adopt from screening.
